import numpy as np

photo = np.array([(507,219),(585,292),(675,403),(755,510),(898,627),(1024,808)],float)
box = np.array([(335,757),(378,805),(436,861),(473,918),(535,977),(576,1040)],float)

def analyze(pts, name):
    c = pts.mean(axis=0)
    X = pts - c
    u,s,vt = np.linalg.svd(X, full_matrices=False)
    axis = vt[0]; perp = np.array([-axis[1], axis[0]])
    if perp[0]<0: perp = -perp  # normalize direction
    proj_s = X @ axis
    proj_p = X @ perp
    order = np.argsort(proj_s)
    print(name, 'axis dir', axis.round(3), 'perp', perp.round(3))
    for i in order:
        print(f'   journal at along={proj_s[i]:7.1f} perp={proj_p[i]:7.1f} sign={"+" if proj_p[i]>0 else "-"}')

analyze(photo,'PHOTO')
analyze(box,'BOXART')
EOF
